text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=ingress-gateway, symptom=5xx-rate-spike, region=eu-west-1, trigger=error_rate>4% over 2m. PD: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-8123 :rotating_light:
olivia: Acked. I'm oncall for eu-west. Seeing a cluster of 502/503s landing on the canary pool. Triage in progress.
kevin: On it. Pulling proxy logs and kv-cache stats. Suspect cache thrash or a bad canary rollout.
maria: Noticed retries are up and route errors cluster to canary instances (canary-3/4). Stable pool mostly 200s.
sre-lead: Quick mitigation proposal: (1) reduce canary traffic to 10% (2) temporarily increase stable pool weight, (3) spin up an extra stable node in eu-west, (4) warm cache. Any objections?
kevin: Doing weight shift now: `routerctl set-weight ingress eu-west canary 0.1` -> running.
kevin: Logs (snippet):
```
[proxy] upstream=canary-3 status=502 path=/v1/generate
[proxy] upstream=stable-1 status=200 path=/v1/generate
[proxy] upstream=canary-4 status=503 path=/v1/generate
```
kevin: kvcache evictions spiked 8x in last 60s, TTL thrash on canary nodes. Scaling stable pool + warming cache.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: acknowledged by olivia. Escalation paused.
maria: After weight change, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.3% in the last 3m. Customer-facing errors appear limited to a subset of requests routed to canary.
olivia: Marking customer impact: partial degradation (affecting ~3% of requests in region). I'll keep monitoring and handoff to night oncall at 12:30 UTC if stable. :thumbsup:
sre-lead: Followups: open a postmortem if error_rate stays >1% for 30m, and add a suppression rule to avoid autopager storms during canary rollbacks.
kevin: Filed a quick ticket to revert the canary image (if still unhealthy) and reduce its rollout pace. PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/rollouts/1234
maria: Nice work everyone — keeping an eye on downstream retries and customer error dashboards.
olivia: Closing loop for now but leaving channel open. Will update if anything flares back up.
